_comment: Synthetic data for demonstration only. Not based on any real organization.

organization.name: Keystone Precision Machining (fictional)
organization.description: Precision machining subcontractor supporting two defense prime contractors.
organization.system_boundary: Managed Windows laptops and desktops, Microsoft 365 tenant, and a managed firewall. No on-premises servers.
organization.fci_types: Purchase orders, contract correspondence, and delivery schedules.

AC1-1.note: Authorized users are managed in Microsoft Entra ID; access is reviewed quarterly.

AC1-2.note: All devices are enrolled in Intune; unenrolled devices are blocked.

AC1-3.note: Conditional access requires sign-in with MFA from compliant devices.

AC2-1.note: Roles are defined for staff, managers, and IT administrators.

AC2-2.note: Standard users have no local administrator rights; IT uses separate admin accounts.

AC3-1.note: Approved external systems are listed in the IT policy.

AC3-2.note: Company data is accessible only from managed devices; personal devices are blocked.

AC4-1.note: The owner approves all public posts.

AC4-2.note: Public content is reviewed before posting and every quarter.

IA1-1.note: Every employee has an individual account; shared accounts are prohibited.

IA1-2.note: Devices and service accounts are named and recorded in Intune and Entra ID.

IA2-1.note: Passwords plus MFA are required for every account.

IA2-2.note: Default passwords are changed as part of the device setup checklist.

MP1-1.note: Drives are destroyed by a certified vendor; certificates are kept.

MP1-2.note: Devices are wiped through Intune before reassignment.

PE1-1.note: Only staff may enter the office; the network closet is limited to IT.

PE1-2.note: Badge access to the office; the network closet is locked.

PE2-1.note: Visitors are escorted at all times.

PE2-2.note: Visitors sign in electronically at reception.

PE2-3.note: Badges are tracked and collected at departure.

SC1-1.note: A managed firewall sits at the internet edge.

SC1-2.note: Inbound traffic is denied by default; the managed service provider reviews alerts daily.

SC2-1.note: Website is hosted externally; guest Wi-Fi is isolated.

SI1-1.note: Vendor security alerts are subscribed; Intune reports missing updates.

SI1-2.note: Critical updates are installed within 14 days through Intune.

SI2-1.note: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint on all devices.

SI2-2.note: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 filters email.

SI4-2.note: Real-time protection is enforced by policy.
